description: This file defines a Swift class `ScreenRecordService` for managing screen recording on macOS, including starting/stopping capture, handling errors, and saving output. It also defines a supporting class `StreamRecorder` for managing AVAssetWriter and capturing video/audio samples.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: A final class providing functionalities to record the screen (and optionally audio) on macOS using ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation. It manages capture configuration, error handling, and output file management.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Asynchronously records the specified screen with given parameters like duration, fps, and audio inclusion. Handles setup, start, stop, and returns the recording file path and whether audio was included.
